name: Tsukumo Haru
source:
“You see, this starry sky is the only thing that connects me and my hometown.”

Haru is an exchange student from Japan, studying astronomy in 17th century England.

Her grandfather was the one to originally move abroad, but Japan closed its borders and isolated itself from the world soon after.

Because of this, Haru was born in England, unable to see the Japan she yearns for.

She is the only person who truly understands [url=/c55332]Alice[/url], and they support each other while spending their days together in Tenbridge.

[Spoiler]Her true identity is revealed to be Edmund Halley.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://solpress.co/projects/newton/]English official site[/url]]
